utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches and could really use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: This Saturday? I thought it was on the 15th in the west lot — or maybe Vik had it wrong?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, Dane, it's this Saturday at the park—not the 15th! Can you help spread the word? We need nails too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Dane, I've got it down as the 15th in the west lot. Did Vik say something different?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I thought it was this Saturday at the community center? Quinn mentioned it was for fixing park benches.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's a different date and location than I have. I'm certain it's the 15th in the west lot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Kira, I was just talking to Cleo about the repair drive. We need some nails—any chance you could help pick some up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Faye—are we sure this repair drive is actually happening? Oren can't even remember the date.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's definitely on — this Sunday afternoon. I'll be there around 1 PM after the kids' games. Maybe Oren just forgot?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Cleo! Are you asking about the repair drive? I think it's this weekend, but I'm fuzzy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it's this Saturday! We're all set on paint, but could really use more nails.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, nails! I might have some in my garage. Let me check later and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Vik, I'm really concerned about the nail shortage. Do you think we can get some more before Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Dane's checking all the supplies, so I'm sure he'll sort out the nail shortage before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief, but I'll feel better once I see the final inventory myself.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Hana, just wanted to let you know the repair drive is actually in the west lot this weekend, not by the park like I mentioned before. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks Tess, I'll note that. The west lot this Saturday, right? Just want to be sure before I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that's right! Saturday is the main repair drive, and then Sunday afternoon we'll be painting and landscaping if you want to help with that too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what's the main goal for this repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The main goal? Oh, it's to fix electronics and small appliances—community center, this Saturday, 10 to 4. I think.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, do we need any special equipment or just basic tools?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, what's this repair drive about? I only caught bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a community effort to fix up the neighborhood—we're meeting at the community center this Saturday at 10 AM to organize tools and supplies, then working Sunday too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought it was at the west lot? Or is it the community center?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, Jules, I just found out it's been moved to Sunday at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, thanks for the update Opal! I'll let Ira and everyone know it's Sunday instead.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, make sure they know it's the community center, not the west lot. I like to be precise about these things.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 10 AM on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, thanks. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think I'll go check the notice board to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's at the community center this Saturday, 10 to 4. Vik told me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I thought I heard Sunday, but maybe I mixed it up. Thanks, Rey.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, do you know what time the repair drive actually starts? I've heard both 9 and 10 and I'm not sure which one to go by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I heard it's at 10 at the community center, from Mara.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks Gus, that helps. I'll probably still show up a bit early just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I heard about the repair drive. Need to borrow any tools? I've got plenty.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. Cleo's bringing the tools, but extra won't hurt—thanks for offering, Gus!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Vik! I'll bring some over on Saturday anyway—just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, hey Hana. Were you wanting to know more about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I've been asking around to make sure I have the full picture before the event.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, it's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. Cleo's bringing tools and Dane's checking supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let me check the flyer again. I'll confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, it's at the community center at 10 AM on Saturday—and we could use more nails if you have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think I have a small box of nails in the garage. I'll bring them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let me check your other coat's left pocket for that list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, good idea, hope that list clears up the date confusion.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, I'll head over to Oren's and check that pocket now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira! Are you free this Saturday? We're organizing a repair drive at the community center starting at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday at 10? Are you sure about that? Oren couldn't even remember the date when I talked to him.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's 10 at the community center, but let me double-check the flyer just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I think it's at the west lot, not the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually Bo, I just heard from Rosa that it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the west lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. Guess I mixed that up too. Thanks for the heads up, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, just wanted to let you know the repair drive's this weekend in the west lot—and Sunday afternoon we're doing painting and landscaping if you can join!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great—thanks for the heads up! I think I'll come Saturday for the repair drive, and maybe Sunday too if I can swing it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful! Let me know if you need a ride or anything—I'm heading over Saturday morning myself.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's to fix up the park benches at the community center, but I'm not sure if it starts at 9 or 10.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have a set time yet, or are we just showing up whenever?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches and could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive—yes, I knew something was happening this weekend! But I thought it was at the community center fixing electronics. Are we doing park benches too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, no, it's definitely the park benches! We're meeting at the park at 9am. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Uli, just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to this Sunday at the community center from 10 to 4. There'll be coffee and snacks!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. Sunday from 10 to 4, I'll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Uli! Feel free to bring any small appliances that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, I'm heading to the repair drive this Sunday after the kids' soccer games. Want to lend a hand with painting and landscaping?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Faye, I thought the repair drive is on the 15th in the west lot. Are you sure it's this Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's definitely this Sunday — I double-checked with Cleo and it's on.
